newsitem.title: UK: Libya postpones deadline for sugar tender -trade.
newsitem.headline: Libya postpones deadline for sugar tender -trade.

text.p: European sugar brokers said on Thursday Libya had postponed a decision on its tender to buy white sugar, possibly because of weakening world prices on the London market.
"I think they have (postponed)...they're not giving any reason," said one broker with a European trade house.
Market sources said it was not yet clear when Libya set the new deadline for replies.
"The only thing I know is that they haven't traded yet."

Another broker suggested Libya might ask the trade houses involved in the tender to re-submit their bids at lower levels to take account of weaker prices on the London futures market. Libya tendered on Tuesday to buy 14,000 tonnes of 45 ICUMSA white sugar for shipment in November/December. Replies were originally scheduled for Thursday. --Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
